aliases: Documents to keep at the time of assessment
banglaExplanation: Assessment শেষ হলেই কাজ শেষ না, কাগজপত্র BTEB requirements অনুযায়ী রাখতে হয়।
কোন documents রাখতে হবে: instruments, registration forms, self check sheet, result sheet, project sheets।
Self check sheet trainees assessment-এর আগে নিজেরাই পূরণ করে।
Recording শেষ হলে এই documents BTEB-তে জমা দিতে হয়, তাই কিছু হারানো চলবে না।

example.bn: প্লাম্বিং assessment-এর পর checklist আর result sheet গুছিয়ে BTEB-তে পাঠানো হয়।
example.en: After a plumbing assessment, the assessor files checklists, registration forms and result sheets. Then he sends them to BTEB.

importance.bn: Short Questions (Short 73) আর CBLM 11 Self Check 2 (Q2): 2 জায়গায় এসেছে। CBLM 11-এ highlight করা আছে। পরীক্ষায় short question হিসেবে আসে। অবশ্যই পড়বেন।

short.modelAnswer:
Documents kept in line with BTEB requirements:
1. Assessment instruments: observation checklists, oral questioning sheets, written test paper
2. Assessment registration forms
3. Assessment self check sheet (completed by trainees prior to assessment)
4. Result sheet for recording competency outcomes
5. Assessment project sheets and specification sheets
These documents are then submitted to BTEB.

realQuestions.question: Name the documents you need to keep at the time of assessment

realQuestions.answer:
Keep observation checklists, oral question sheets, written tests,
registration and self-assessment forms, result sheets, project/specification sheets
and other assessment records securely.
